args.message: Hi Aisha - I have NOT released payment for Kestrel KE-8246 (doc 5100005808, 19,540.50) and KE-5596 (doc 5100005813, 6,470.25). The Harbor Bank ****4471 statement shows a wire out on 2026-03-30 to Kestrel Electronics, ref 'WIRE OUT TP-0330-07', for 26,010.75 USD - exactly the sum of these two invoices. That wire is not recorded in the ERP (no payment document, no GL entry), which is why both still show as open/overdue in AP aging. Paying them again today would very likely be a duplicate payment. Suggested next step: confirm with Treasury who sent TP-0330-07 and what it covered; if it covers these two invoices, record/clear it against docs 5100005808 and 5100005813 rather than paying. If Treasury confirms the wire was for something else, let me know and I will release the payment same day. Note: Kestrel KE-26677 (doc 5100005695, 4,250.50, due today) is separately in proposed run F110-0331-A tonight - I left that untouched.
